description: Government & Policy: Uttar Pradesh plans robotics and deep-tech hubs in Noida and Lucknow, backed by PRAGATI, U Hubs, future-skills training and a more investor-focused IT policy.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh has outlined plans to build a broader deep-tech ecosystem spanning robotics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), quantum computing, semiconductor design and advanced manufacturing. At a review meeting of the state’s Information Technology and Electronics Department, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath directed officials to prepare a comprehensive action plan aimed at positioning Uttar Pradesh as a national centre for emerging technologies.
